errors_encountered.error: warning CS8618: Non-nullable property 'Title'/'ClassType' must contain a non-null value when exiting constructor (SampleConfiguration.cs Scenario class)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The migrated SDK-sample model class (copied verbatim from the UWP source, which had no nullable context) has non-nullable auto-properties ('string Title', 'Type ClassType'); the WinUI scaffold enables <Nullable>enable</Nullable>, so the compiler flags them.
errors_encountered.fix: Initialized the properties (Title = string.Empty; ClassType = typeof(object)). session-log turns 1-3, lines 4552-4610.

errors_encountered.error: & : The module '.github' could not be loaded
errors_encountered.root_cause: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 invoked via a bare relative path with backslashes; PowerShell treats a leading 'name\...' token as a module-qualified command, so the script was never executed and $LASTEXITCODE was left unchanged (0).
errors_encountered.fix: Re-invoked with the absolute path. session-log turns 4-5, lines 4615-4646.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Validator command emitted '& : The module '.github' could not be loaded' and never ran, but printed VALIDATE_EXIT=0.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Relative script path with backslashes parsed as a module-qualified command; failure does not set $LASTEXITCODE.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Re-invoked the script with an absolute path.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: SKILL.md stating that skill scripts must be invoked via an absolute (or .\-prefixed) path, and that a relative 'dir\script.ps1' silently fails without changing $LASTEXITCODE.

dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: SDK-sample model class with non-nullable auto-properties under the nullable-enabled WinUI scaffold.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A 'Common build errors' entry naming CS8618 on migrated model/config classes and the one-line fix.
